**Functional assignment:** This 196-amino-acid sequence is an exact, full-length match to reviewed UniProt protein **Q9JXS2**, a **7-methyl-GTP pyrophosphatase** from *Neisseria meningitidis*.

**Reaction catalyzed:**

\[
\text{N}^7\text{-methyl-GTP} + \mathrm{H_2O}
\rightarrow \text{N}^7\text{-methyl-GMP} + \text{diphosphate} + \mathrm{H^+}
\]

The reaction is recorded as **Rhea RHEA:58744**. The enzyme is annotated as requiring a **divalent metal cation**; its EC assignment is only specified broadly as **EC 3.6.1.-**.

In brief, it hydrolyzes the triphosphate group of N⁷-methyl-GTP, yielding the corresponding monophosphate and diphosphate. UniProt suggests it may help prevent modified nucleotides from being incorporated into cellular nucleic acids, but that broader cellular role is less certain than the sequence-matched enzyme and reaction assignment.
